items.rule_a: Before committing/pushing, start the server with `PORT=3457 node server.js &`, curl `localhost:3457/` and `localhost:3457/api/version`, confirm the expected body and status, then stop the server.
items.rule_b: Use `-RedirectStandardOutput NUL -RedirectStandardError NUL` to truly background servers in PowerShell.

items.rule_a: When adding a complete new level and adding new objects, create or modify the object code files game/objects/XX-name.c and .h.
items.rule_b: When adding a new object, create `game/objects/XX-name/` with a JSON descriptor and C or ASM source.

items.rule_a: Never force push the fork main branch to fix version state.
items.rule_b: Force-push the reset main branch to origin for each fork.

items.rule_a: When invoking PowerShell inline from Bash, call `powershell -File script.ps1`.
items.rule_b: When invoking PowerShell inline from Bash, use single quotes around the whole `-Command` argument.

items.rule_a: After applying file patches, restart the MCP server by removing and re-adding it and starting a new session.
items.rule_b: Never run the one-time bootstrap `claude mcp add claude-flow -- npx -y @sparkleideas/ruflo@latest`; only the user runs it, once.

items.rule_a: Before committing/pushing, start the server with `PORT=3457 node server.js &`, curl `localhost:3457/` and `localhost:3457/api/version`, confirm the expected body and status, then stop the server.
items.rule_b: Never run the backend or frontend directly on Windows.

items.rule_a: Skip any task that touches a client mod loader or a client-side bridge.
items.rule_b: Implement client mods through real Fabric.

items.rule_a: Before committing/pushing, start the server with `PORT=3457 node server.js &`, curl `localhost:3457/` and `localhost:3457/api/version`, confirm the expected body and status, then stop the server.
items.rule_b: The coordinator must enforce the NUL redirection pattern for any background server start.

items.rule_a: Both unit tests and integration tests are required.
items.rule_b: If a feature genuinely cannot be tested at one of the two levels, state that explicitly to the user when reporting completion rather than skipping silently.

items.rule_a: Move forward only; do not attempt to reset or rewind published state.
items.rule_b: Delete scripts/.last-promoted-version and scripts/.last-build-state.

items.rule_a: When the conversion is scheduled, create lib/pipeline-node.mjs containing shared Node.js pipeline utilities (logging, timing, state, git helpers, retry).
items.rule_b: Place source code files in `/src`.

items.rule_a: Always run `npm run deploy` to execute the full deploy pipeline.
items.rule_b: When asked to test the pipeline, use `npm run deploy`, or use `bash scripts/sync-and-build.sh --force` to force a build even when there are no new merges.

items.rule_a: When adding a new object, create `game/objects/XX-name/` with a JSON descriptor and C or ASM source.
items.rule_b: For a new `.c` source file in the Xcode project, set `explicitFileType = sourcecode.cpp.objcpp`, `fileEncoding = 4`, `path = "../game/objects/XX-name.c"`, and `sourceTree = SOURCE_ROOT`.

items.rule_a: Never delete git branches.
items.rule_b: You may delete merged branches only after the user asks.

items.rule_a: Do not guess, read source code, or check GitHub to answer questions about claude-flow.
items.rule_b: Only after running the matching CLI command(s) and checking memory may you fall back to reading source code or docs.

items.rule_a: When starting Node/Express servers, use Start-Process with -NoNewWindow, -WindowStyle Hidden, and stdout/stderr redirected to NUL.
items.rule_b: Before committing/pushing, start the server with `PORT=3457 node server.js &`, curl `localhost:3457/` and `localhost:3457/api/version`, confirm the expected body and status, then stop the server.

items.rule_a: Delete all map and player data as part of pre-test setup.
items.rule_b: Never delete world save files such as server-world.dat, server-players.dat, or similar without explicit user permission.

items.rule_a: Redirect a background server's output to NUL to detach the process from the shell.
items.rule_b: Before committing/pushing, start the server with `PORT=3457 node server.js &`, curl `localhost:3457/` and `localhost:3457/api/version`, confirm the expected body and status, then stop the server.

items.rule_a: When continuing work, execute the "Sprint Actions" listed in the relevant sprint section.
items.rule_b: For now, skip the Sprint 5 mail delivery guarantee and take no action on it.

items.rule_a: Always redirect both stdout and stderr to NUL when starting background servers.

items.rule_a: Never save pipeline state before the publish succeeds.
items.rule_b: Commit the reconciled state with the message "Reconcile published-versions + clear state for clean-slate release".

items.rule_b: When invoking PowerShell inline from Bash, use single quotes around the whole `-Command` argument.

items.rule_a: Leave merged branches in place rather than removing them.

items.rule_a: After starting a background server, wait 3 seconds before proceeding.
items.rule_b: Never use fixed timeouts to wait for external service readiness.

items.rule_a: Do not manually hack or modify pipeline state.
items.rule_b: Delete scripts/.last-promoted-version and scripts/.last-build-state.

items.rule_a: When generating project configuration, generate `.claude-flow/config.json` rather than `config.yaml`.
items.rule_b: Place configuration files in `/config`.

items.rule_a: Do not add shared constants, config, or indirection for values that are fixed requirements, such as the 2/1 image caps.
items.rule_b: In both modes, cap drawn images in the backend by having resolveSelection slice to MAX_CHARACTERS or MAX_CHAPTERS.

items.rule_a: For Beta BlockPlacement C2S, keep the damage field as a `byte` to preserve phantom KeepAlive compatibility.
items.rule_b: For Beta 1.8 (v17) BlockPlacement, use `short damage` in `PlayerBlockPlacementPacketV17`, not `byte`.

items.rule_a: When learning is not persisting, check that the full 916-line version of `intelligence.cjs` is loaded rather than the stub.
items.rule_b: Keep every file under 500 lines.

items.rule_a: For work touching 3+ files, a new feature, or cross-module refactoring, spawn agents.
items.rule_b: When in doubt about task complexity, start working directly and escalate to agents only if the scope grows.

items.rule_b: For dev servers on Windows, use Git Bash `nohup process &` with stdout/stderr redirected to a file, or use `desktop-commander_start_process` to manage the process lifecycle.
